items.title: Nick Polites Interview, 1963-10-08
items.q: They were based on, mainly on the records, Bunk Johnson, George Lewis and those men made

ctx.x: And this is in the forties mostly you're talking about?

Um, into the fifties too. Um. Um. No one, uh, took, uh, any great heed of the, um, Bunk Johnson, George Lewis, uh, type of band when it came out, um, until, um, 1957 when the Melbourne New Orleans Band, uh, started. Um. Um. They stayed very much in the old, uh, mold of, uh, King Oliver Lou Bottas, sort of thing.
Well, uh, back to Frank Johnson. Who was the star of that band? Was Johnson himself a star? I know.
